Fit a TOP model with validated inputs and named results

Source: R/top_fit.R
top_fit.Rd

This is the recommended interface for new analyses. The original [TwoStageModel()] function remains available for backward compatibility.

Usage

top_fit(
  y,
  baseline = NULL,
  additive = NULL,
  pairwise = NULL,
  saturated = NULL,
  missing_value = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  subtype_cutoff = 10
)

Arguments

y

Numeric matrix or data frame whose first column is case-control status (0/1) and remaining columns are tumor characteristics. Tumor characteristics must be `NA` for controls.

baseline

Covariates with a common baseline effect across subtypes.

additive

Covariates using the additive second-stage model.

pairwise

Covariates using the pairwise-interaction model.

saturated

Covariates using the saturated model.

missing_value

Numeric code used for missing tumor characteristics in cases, or `NULL` when case tumor data are complete.

start

Optional starting vector for second-stage parameters.

subtype_cutoff

Subtypes with counts at or below this value are omitted, matching the historical TOP behavior.

Value

A named list of class `top_model`.
